info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, radians, Ypos, podsFront, loopX, loopWidth, cableGuy, COPTER, firstPhotoglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gXVelChange, gScoreon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  COPTER = sprite(4)  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  Xpos = float(this.locH)  this.locZ = 1000  firstPhoto = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.ink = 0    if (Xpos > 50) and (Xpos < 462) then      if cableGuy.takingPhoto = 1 then        xDiff = float(cableGuy.locH - this.locH)        yDiff = float(cableGuy.locV - this.locV)        distToCopter = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        if distToCopter < 200 then          gScore = gScore + (100 * (1 - (distToCopter / 200.0)))          this.ink = 33          if firstPhoto < 2 then            gScore = gScore + (1000 * (1 - (distToCopter / 200.0)))            puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))            firstPhoto = firstPhoto + 1          end if        end if      end if    end if    this.locH = Xpos  end ifend
